description: This file defines classes and methods for managing sales orders, sale order lines, sale shops, and sale configuration policies in an OpenERP (Odoo) module, including order creation, invoicing, shipment, and related workflows.

classes.name: sale_shop
classes.description: Model representing a sales shop with associated payment terms, warehouse, pricelist, and analytic account.

classes.name: sale_order
classes.description: Model representing a sales order with methods for order management, invoicing, shipment, and workflow handling.

classes.name: sale_order_line
classes.description: Model representing individual lines within a sales order, including product details, quantities, pricing, and invoicing.

classes.name: sale_config_picking_policy
classes.description: Transient model for configuring default picking and shipping policies.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Creates a copy of the sale order with default draft state and new sequence number.

methods.name: _amount_line_tax
methods.description: Calculates total tax amount for a sale order line.

methods.name: _amount_all
methods.description: Computes total untaxed amount, tax, and total for a sale order.

methods.name: _picked_rate
methods.description: Calculates the percentage of items picked/shipped for a sale order.

methods.name: _invoiced_rate
methods.description: Calculates the percentage of invoiced amount for a sale order.

methods.name: _invoiced
methods.description: Determines if a sale order is fully invoiced.

methods.name: _invoiced_search
methods.description: Search method for filtering sale orders based on invoicing status.

methods.name: _get_order
methods.description: Retrieves sale order IDs associated with sale order lines.

methods.name: unlink
methods.description: Deletes sale orders if they are in draft or canceled state.

methods.name: onchange_shop_id
methods.description: Updates sale order fields based on selected shop.

methods.name: action_cancel_draft
methods.description: Resets sale order to draft state, clears invoices and shipment status.

methods.name: onchange_partner_id
methods.description: Updates partner-related fields when partner is changed.

methods.name: shipping_policy_change
methods.description: Adjusts invoice quantity policy based on shipping policy.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Overrides write method to synchronize invoice quantity with order policy.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Overrides create method to set invoice quantity based on order policy.

methods.name: button_dummy
methods.description: Placeholder method, returns True.

methods.name: _inv_get
methods.description: Placeholder for generating invoice data, currently returns empty dict.

methods.name: _make_invoice
methods.description: Creates an invoice for a sale order, copying existing draft invoices if any.

methods.name: action_invoice_create
methods.description: Generates invoices for selected sale orders, grouped or individual.

methods.name: action_invoice_cancel
methods.description: Cancels invoices linked to sale orders and updates line invoiced status.

methods.name: action_invoice_end
methods.description: Finalizes invoicing, updates line and order states accordingly.

methods.name: action_cancel
methods.description: Cancels sale orders, including related pickings and invoices, with workflow validation.

methods.name: action_wait
methods.description: Sets sale order to progress or manual state, logs event.

methods.name: procurement_lines_get
methods.description: Retrieves procurement IDs linked to sale order lines.

methods.name: test_state
methods.description: Checks if all lines are finished or if any are canceled, updates line states.

methods.name: action_ship_create
methods.description: Creates stock pickings and procurements for sale order lines, confirms workflows.

methods.name: action_ship_end
methods.description: Marks sale order as shipped and updates line states.

methods.name: _log_event
methods.description: Logs a sale order event for tracking.

methods.name: has_stockable_products
methods.description: Checks if sale order contains stockable products.
